name: Don’t Miss Your Flight! ✈️
desc:
✈️ Welcome to Don’t Miss Your Flight!

🎫 Grab your boarding pass—your adventure starts now!
🏃 Race to your gate before it closes!
💺 Find your seat, buckle up, and get ready for takeoff!
🗼 Fly to Paris and discover what awaits when you land!
🌍 Play again to unlock more destinations around the world!

👀 Where will your next flight take you?
